title: Integrated handshake + live-invoke onboarding canvas for API SDK quickstart
creator: Maya Rivera
description: Create a compact, modular canvas of visual assets for the API/SDK quickstart that demonstrates the credential handshake, token lifecycle, streaming connection, and a simple live tool-invoke flow. These assets will be used in the public docs quickstart, SDK readme, and an in-console guided tour. The goal is to make the first-run experience feel reliable for engineers: show what to expect at each step, common failure states, and recommended remediation. Assets should include static step cards, one 9-frame GIF for live-invoke, an annotated screenshot set for the console, and a small vector diagram for the credential handshake.
acceptance_criteria: A set of 6 step-cards (1200x675 px) covering: signup key creation, local SDK install, handshake request, token caching, open streaming connection, basic tool invoke
One 9-frame GIF illustrating a single streaming + tool-invoke roundtrip with clear intro/outro frames
Annotated console screenshots (3) showing where to find keys, rotate secrets, and enable streaming permissions
Figma file with component tokens and exportable slices; naming convention follows docs-quickstart/handshake/*
Assets reviewed and approved by PM (Priya Singh) and engineering owner (Noah Williams)
All image exports in PNG (web-optimized) + SVG source where applicable and uploaded to Drive and the docs asset CDN
